title: A fact past the view of a long page

steps.post: @browser the department's equipment register is at http://fixtures/northmoor/equipment-register.html. Which room holds asset NM-EQ-3411, what is it, and who is its custodian?

groundTruth.pageChars: about 346,000 characters of table text, about five times a browser snapshot's 60,000-character view; the row sits about nine tenths of the way down

pass: The reply gives room B-117 PDB, the eye tracker (1200 Hz), and custodian I. Mbeki for NM-EQ-3411, each read from a result the turn read.

checks.text: The row was reached by reading on past the first view (results__read by offset or find, or a fetch window at an offset or a find), not by guessing from the part first shown.
No call fetched or opened the whole page again after its result was recorded, when reading on from that result would have reached the row.
